{% raw %}
How to run a championship week to week once an admin has set it up (see [**Sim Racing setup**](/guides/simracing-setup/)).

## Results after a round

On the round's post press **🏁 Results**, then the session (Qualifying, Race…). Type the finishing order, one car a line: a car number ("#12" or "12") or the driver's name. Add a time after it if you have one ("12 1:02:33.4"). Below that, list retirements (DNF) and anyone disqualified or who did not start ("#7 dsq").

You see a preview with each car's points before anything is saved. **Save results** saves them, marks everyone who raced as attending, and updates the standings. Saving the same session again replaces it.

## Points this round

On the round's screen, **Points this round** makes a round count double (a finale), half, or nothing.

## Incident reports

Drivers press **🚩 Report an incident** on the round's post, from the start of the round until the reporting window closes. Each report is posted in the stewards' channel with its own thread for discussion.

On a report's card a steward presses **⚖️ Give a penalty** or **✅ No further action**, and writes the reason: drivers read it. The drivers involved and the reporter are told by direct message, and the decision is posted in the decisions channel if you have one. **➕ Another penalty** adds one to a decided report (both drivers at fault, say).

## Penalties

- **Time penalty**: seconds added to a driver's race time, which changes the order only when times were typed in. Without times, use a position penalty.
- **Position penalty**: moved down that many places among the finishers.
- **Points deduction**: off their championship total, never dropped.
- **Disqualified**: no position, no points in that session.
- **Grid penalty** and **race ban**: for the next round. A banned driver is kept off that round's grid.
- **Warning**, and **penalty points** on a driver's licence (Premium), with a race ban flagged at your threshold.

A round's screen also has **⚖️ Give a penalty** without a report. Every penalty sits on top of the results: in **Penalties**, removing one puts the result back as it was.

## The standings

**📊 Standings** shows them privately. The standings post shows drivers (per class, if you have classes) and teams. **📊 My results** shows a driver their own rounds, and **🗓️ Results by round** any round's classification.
